title: Scalar/tensor pullback normalization on a K-flat representative
statement: Let A and B be commutative rings, phi:A -> B a ring map, f:Z -> W a scheme morphism, E_T the derived scalar extension and U_T the exact scalar restriction of [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], F_A and F_B the exact derived inverse images of [def-kun-projection-formula-map], a:F_A U_W ~= U_Z F_B the comparison of [lem-sbc-canonical-restrict-scalars-functor-comparisons], and e_T:U_T E_T ~= (- tensor_A^L B_T[0]) the representative-normalized scalar/tensor isomorphism of [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Let P be a K-flat cochain complex of A-module sheaves on W, and let c:F_B E_W Q(P) -> E_Z F_A Q(P) be any morphism. Suppose that c, followed by E_Z of the geometric representative and then the scalar-extension representative at F_A P, equals F_B of the scalar-extension representative at P followed by the B-geometric representative and the localization of the ordinary scalar/pullback isomorphism. The latter ordinary isomorphism is the conjugate of the sectionwise lower-star/scalar-restriction identity under the two composite ordinary adjunctions. Then, at C=Q(P), in composition order, a_(E_W C) ; U_Z(c) ; e_Z(F_A C) equals F_A(e_W C) ; delta_(C,B_W[0]) ; (F_A C tensor_A^L -)(t). Here delta is the specified inverse-image tensor comparison of [def-kun-projection-formula-map], and t:F_A(B_W[0]) ~= B_Z[0] is exact inverse image on the single coefficient sheaf followed by the ordinary restriction/pullback comparison and the inverse of the monoidal B-pullback unit map. No direct-image functor, projection-formula mate, or boundedness assumption occurs.

proof.text: Use the ordinary balancing isomorphisms and their pullback square. Apply that square degreewise to P and localize. All complex composition comparison factors are the canonical identity maps on their components.

Use the single-coefficient derived tensor counit square. Since P is K-flat its localization tensorator is invertible. The tensor comparison, coefficient iso, geometric representatives and ordinary tensor/pullback comparison are isomorphisms; the square therefore proves the target-side tensor representative invertible without needing a separate preservation-of-K-flatness lemma. Use the explicit scalarTensorRepresentative endpoint transport, so the native scalar tensor functor is shared throughout.

Postcompose the desired equality with tensoring the geometric representative followed by the target tensor representative and localized balancing map. This is an isomorphism by the preceding step. Naturality of scalarTensorIso and its defining representative normalization identify the left side with exact restriction of hc. Naturality and the exact restriction/pullback representative equation turn it into inverse image of the source normalized representative followed by the ordinary square.

Apply the localized ordinary balancing square from the first step, then the tensor representative square from the second. The two postcomposed morphisms agree. Cancel the isomorphism to obtain the original equality, with its statement unchanged.

theorem scalarTensorPullback_normalization_kFlat
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {Z W : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ W)
    (P : CochainComplex (Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) ℤ)
    (_hP : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ)).kFlat P)
    (c : L(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) f).obj
        ((scalarExtension φ W).obj (_root_.DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) ⟶
      (scalarExtension φ Z).obj
        (L(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).obj (_root_.DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)))
    (hc : c ≫ (scalarExtension φ Z).map (scalarGeometricRepresentative A f P) ≫
          scalarExtensionRepresentative φ Z
            (((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) =
        L(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) f).map (scalarExtensionRepresentative φ W P) ≫
          scalarGeometricRepresentative B f
            (((ProEtale.etaleSheafExtendScalars φ W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
          _root_.DerivedCategory.Q.map ((scalarSheafPullbackComplexIso φ f).hom.app P)) :
    let C := _root_.DerivedCategory.Q.obj P
    (scalarRestrictionPullbackIso φ f).hom.app ((scalarExtension φ W).obj C) ≫
        (Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars Z.smallEtaleTopology φ).map c ≫
        (scalarTensorIso φ Z).hom.app (L(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).obj C) =
      L(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).map ((scalarTensorIso φ W).hom.app C) ≫
        ((leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).app C).app
          (scalarCoefficient φ W) ≫
        ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Z).obj
          (L(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).obj C)).map
          (scalarCoefficientPullbackIso φ f).hom
